SRE ensures that Google Cloud's services-both our internally critical and our externally-visible systems-have reliability, uptime appropriate to customer's needs and a fast rate of improvement.
Additionally SRE's will keep an ever-watchful eye on our systems capacity and performance.
Much of our software development focuses on optimizing existing systems, building infrastructure and eliminating work through automation.
On the SRE team, you'll have the opportunity to manage the complex challenges of scale which are unique to Google Cloud, while using your expertise in coding, algorithms, complexity analysis and large-scale system design.
SRE's culture of intellectual curiosity, problem solving and openness is key to its success.
Our organization brings together people with a wide variety of backgrounds, experiences and perspectives.
We encourage them to collaborate, think big and take risks in a blame-free environment.
We promote self-direction to work on meaningful projects, while we also strive to create an environment that provides the support and mentorship needed to learn and grow.
Our Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) team combines software engineering and systems administration to build and operate some of the world's most complex distributed systems.
As an SRE Manager, you will lead a team of engineers tasked with ensuring our services are fast, reliable, and available.
You will balance the development of new features with the long-term health and stability of the production environment.

job_title: Board Design Manager
section_intro:
Google's mission is to organize the world's information and make it universally accessible and useful.
As a Staff Board Design Engineer within the Silicon Systems and Engineering team, you will serve as the lead technical authority driving the architecture, schematic design, and complex layout of mission-critical printed circuit board platforms that power Google's next-generation custom silicon-including Google Cloud Axion central processing units and Tensor Processing Units.
In this role, you will lead the end-to-end hardware development of advanced Reference Validation Platforms, silicon characterization boards, and high-density test fixtures.
You will manage bleeding-edge electrical, thermal, and mechanical tests-from designing high-current multi-phase power delivery networks to routing multi-gigabit high-speed serial links across ultra-high-layer-count substrates.
The ML, Systems, & Cloud AI (MSCA) organization at Google designs, implements, and manages the hardware, software, machine learning, and systems infrastructure for all Google services (Search, YouTube, etc.) and Google Cloud.
Our end users are Googlers, Cloud customers and the billions of people who use Google services around the world.
We prioritize security, efficiency, and reliability across everything we do - from developing our latest TPUs to running a global network, while driving towards shaping the future of hyperscale computing.
Our global impact spans software and hardware, including Google Cloud's Vertex AI, the leading AI platform for bringing Gemini models to enterprise customers.
section_responsibilities:
Define system specifications, block diagrams, power trees, clock distribution topologies, and component selection for server-class silicon validation platforms and characterization fixtures.
Drive schematic capture and guided physical layout for high-density interconnect, ultra-high-layer-count (24+ layers) printed circuit boards utilizing advanced dielectric materials using Cadence Allegro, Concept, and OrCAD.
Partner with Signal Integrity and Power Integrity teams to implement decoupling strategies, multi-phase voltage regulator module designs capable of delivering high-current rails (>500 amperes to 1000+ amperes), and impedance-controlled high-speed routing.
Direct post-silicon board bring-up in the laboratory using high-speed oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and thermal imaging; mentored team members and established organization-wide hardware design guidelines.
Enforce strict Design for Manufacturing, Design for Assembly, and Design for Test guidelines; partnered with printed circuit board fabricators and electronics manufacturing service assembly houses to resolve technical issues and optimize yield.
section_requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
10 years of experience in high-speed, multi-layer board-level hardware design.
5 years of experience managing teams.
Experience designing and routing high-speed digital interfaces (e.g., PCIe Gen6, DDR5/LPDDR6, USB4, I3C, SPI, high-speed SerDes) and clock distribution networks.
Experience in schematic capture and PCB layout tools (specifically Cadence Allegro Design Authoring/Concept HDL and Allegro PCB Editor).
Experience designing multi-phase point-of-load (PoL) voltage regulators, high-efficiency DC-DC converters, power sequencing, and high-transient power delivery systems.
section_preferred:
Master's degree in Electrical Engineering or Computer Engineering with a focus on Hardware Systems, Power Electronics, or High-Speed Circuit Design.
12 years of experience designing Reference Validation Platforms (RVPs), ATE characterization boards, or server motherboards for enterprise CPUs or AI/ML accelerators (TPUs/GPUs).
Experience designing ultra-high-current power delivery networks (>1000A) with advanced digital multi-phase PWM controllers (PMBus/AVS).
Experience leading multi-disciplinary engineering projects, driving ODM/EMS vendors, and mentoring junior/mid-level hardware engineers.
Deep knowledge of HDI, micro-vias, rigid-flex, low-loss laminate selection, and advanced manufacturing capabilities at PCB fabrication vendors.

job_title: Group Product Manager, PDLC Tooling, Work AI
location: San Jose, CA, USA; New York, NY, USA; San Francisco, CA, USA
section_intro:
AI has changed how software gets written at Google.
Coding is much faster, so the rest of the product development lifecycle (PDLC) is now the bottleneck.
When building is cheap, the most expensive mistake is building the wrong thing, yet deciding what to build still runs at human speed on tools built for a pre-agentic world.
Work AI, part of Dev AI, exists to change that.
You will direct product for PDLC Tooling, the agentic tools Google's designers, Product Managers (PMs), and User Experience (UX) researchers use to decide what to build and how it should work.
Unlike engineers, they lack a single source of truth and a mature toolchain.
Evidence is scattered, static mocks hide real behavior, alternatives are costly to explore, and design intent is lost.
Our goal is to make it cheap, so what ships are the best of many options, not the first one that worked.
This role builds on early momentum: our internal tools let teams design and prototype directly on production code, and collaborative canvases provide high-fidelity prototyping and feedback.
Your mandate is to scale this work across Google, unite partner efforts across Core, Search, and DeepMind into one coherent experience, and extend it to every UX, PM, and research workflow.
US: $240000 - $333000 (USD) + 25% bonus target + equity + benefits
section_responsibilities:
Set the goal, strategy, and roadmap for PDLC Tooling.
Build and lead a team of PMs while personally owning the zero-to-one initiatives.
Scale production-grounded prototyping so teams explore high-fidelity variants on real design systems and data, and carry the winning design into production code.
Bring agents into PM and UX research workflows, from evidence-backed briefs and living plans to synthetic users, AI-moderated research, and scaled experiments.
Open a guardrailed path for non-engineers to ship well-scoped changes to production, and partner with DeepMind on design evaluations so internal usage improves Gemini.
Engage lighthouse teams to iterate quickly, own north-star metrics such as time from intent to validated prototype, and lead the narrative for how Google builds in the agentic era.

10 years of product management experience at a technology company, including experience driving zero-to-one products from concept to adoption.
3 years of experience in people management, leading product managers and cross-functional teams.

Experience shipping products powered by Large Language Models (LLMs) or AI agents.

Experience shipping agentic products with measurable quality, including defining evaluations and metrics and improving against them.
Experience building platforms and extensibility models, such as plugins, APIs, and design-system integrations.
Experience driving adoption and behavior change across large, user communities, including non-engineers.
Understanding of the product development lifecycle and empathy for design and research craft, with strong product and design taste.
Technical acumen to collaborate with engineers and researchers, and prototyping with AI tools.

The Shopping Graph is Google's comprehensive, interconnected dataset of commercial information, designed to power various shopping experiences across Google services, including Search, Ads, YouTube, Discover, Chrome, and the Gemini App.
The Shopping Product Graph is a key subset focused on modeling billions of purchasable products, their complex relationships, and their visual, subjective, and specification-based attributes.
By synthesizing information from web crawls, merchant catalogs, and manufacturer inputs, we own the discovery, creation, and linking of all entities to form a shared, highly accurate, and complete commercial model that empowers millions of merchants and billions of users globally.
As a Principal Engineer for the Shopping Product Graph Data Infrastructure, you will drive the architectural evolution of Google's global commerce data ecosystem.
You will dictate the long-term data infrastructure strategy, architecting systems capable of managing billions of entities while maintaining exceptional resilience and scale in the agentic commerce era.
You will operate at the intersection of advanced machine learning and large-scale distributed systems, driving a step-function change in capability, quality, and execution velocity.
You will ensure our product modeling and understanding seamlessly power new AI-driven capabilities in Search, Ads, and YouTube.
Your technical leadership will impact thousands of engineers, billions of users, and a core pillar of Google's business generation.
As a Principal Engineer, you will not only design industry-leading systems but also cultivate an engineering culture of excellence, mentoring senior technical leaders and setting the standard for data-driven product innovation.
People shop on Google more than a billion times a day - and the Commerce team is responsible for building the experiences that serve these users.
The mission for Google Commerce is to be an essential part of the shopping journey for consumers - from inspiration to to a simple and secure checkout experience - and the best place for retailers/merchants to connect with consumers.
We support and partner with the commerce ecosystem, from large retailers to small local merchants, to give them the tools, technology and scale to thrive in today's digital world.
US: $307000 - $427000 (USD) + 30% bonus target + equity + benefits
section_responsibilities:
Architect the end-to-end technical strategy for the next generation of the Shopping Product Graph data infrastructure, building resilient, planetary-scale systems that power Google's commercial AI experiences.
Partner closely with executive stakeholders, engineering directors, and product leadership across Search, Ads, and YouTube to align advanced infrastructural capabilities with broad, multi-year strategic business objectives.
Advocate for the integration of LLM inference and large-scale clustering techniques into the core data infrastructure, bridging advanced research with massive-scale consumer applications.
Establish industry-leading standards for data-driven product quality, pioneering advanced experimentation and LLM-based evaluation frameworks to accelerate engineering iteration and model accuracy.
Serve as a cornerstone of technical excellence, actively guiding, mentoring, and elevating a large organization of Senior Staff and Staff Engineers to solve Google's ambiguous and complex commerce challenges.
